method: Audit M4; two fresh processes per case and budget with identical copied inputs. First iteration cold; 10 ms timer, 300 ms before and 80 ms after calls, no forced GC; profile interval 1 ms. Frame copies/recovery/media removal disabled. Default T6 uses copied forge, limits and deployment ledger. The albums case selects the existing empty-forge fallback to keep four pending album lookups in every pass; both versions use that fallback. External load is recorded and uncontrolled.

readiness.condition: before each run the done world's 60 s archive copy is cleared and the hot list read once, as between production passes; frame copies, recovery and media removal left out
